sponsor_tech.zetaris: Federated SQL over POS tickets/items/table events (PostgreSQL) plus rosters/plate returns/reviews (second store); Investigator queries and Verifier re-queries both go through Zetaris
sponsor_tech.meterless: Meterless Nightshift is the primary model provider (Runtime URL, token and model id are configurable in the Settings screen or .env). The World Model engine is implemented in-repo from Meterless' reference architecture: WorldStoreService + IngestPipelineService + ContextBuilderService as shared hypothesis/evidence state with provenance; the Verifier reads the context builder
